name: FIC Global, Inc.
summary: FIC Global, Inc. engages in research, development, manufacturing, and sales of optical communications. The company provides automotive products, surveillance products, and industrial computers, as well as the electronic manufacturing of computers and servers. It also offers optical transceiver, precision electronics, satcom, marine electronics, emergency response, smart mobility, smart city, smart screen, and vulnerability scans. FIC Global, Inc. was founded in 1979 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
